information_requirements: PIR: Which official doctrine defines METL-based training and evaluation?
PIR: How do official staff-organization sources describe annex ownership?

planned_sources.access_method: Fetch FM 7-0 from the official Army publishing portal and archive the PDF.
expected_claims: METL designates mission-essential tasks with conditions and standards.
Proficiency is evaluated per task, not per unit as a whole.

planned_sources.access_method: Retrieve the defense research institute commentary on training management.
expected_claims: Analytical framing of how readiness reporting drives task assignment.

planned_sources.access_method: Scan practitioner blog posts as search leads only.
expected_claims: Hypotheses about field usage of crawl-walk-run progressions, to be confirmed against tier A.

collection_sequence.action: Extract the METL definition and evaluation standards from the primary text.
Cross-check the primary claims against the research commentary.
Harvest leads and mark every unconfirmed statement as a hypothesis.

gaps: No accessible primary source yet for ROK-specific doctrine detail; tracked as an open question.
